title:
Our recent visit to the Met Theatre in Bury was well received by the Meet Me At The Met community group attendees. 

Thank you all so much for your time and attention!

Our, Introduction To Ukulele workshop is intended for beginners and complete novice players. 

Intermediate players may also find the session insightful and helpful for improving those important foundation techniques and ironing out any bad habits.

We intend to give over the course of 2 hours the best starting advice and tips to your group and give you the best start on your journey to the powerful yet delicate music of the ukulele.

No experience or instrument required.

If you're community group, school, workplace, event or other venue are interested in us bringing over a big box of ukuleles and delivering our Introduction To Ukulele workshop, please email: ukegroupnorth@gmail for details today!
